learning_outcomes.text: Provide knowledge and skills on key issues of lighting and installation equipment: terminology, variables, indicators, classifications, methods, element base, electrical circuit solutions safeguards, content projects, measurements and other.

Reinforce knowledge and skills to create a practical implementation of the basic methods, approaches, solutions and structures in the design of the lighting system and the electrical system of a small residential, industrial, public or other building.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts, light quantities and units
Technology to design of electrical installations
assessment_rules: The exam is written with two questions. The final assessment takes into account the assessment of coursework.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
